# CP7-pre-7: Dominant-Failure Tracklet Topology (FP7oJQ)

*Generated by `tools/cp7_pre7_failure_topology.py`. Read-only diagnostic.*

## 1. Purpose

Resolve the internal contradiction between CP7-pre-2 (95-99% of
fragmentation is concurrent, both tracklets alive) and CP7-pre-3
(70-78% is detection under-segmentation, one box spanning a pair).
Classifies each misattributed contiguous span into topology buckets
that determine the Lever-2 implementation path.

## 2. Production Root Verification

Detections at `outputs/_eval_gt/FP7oJQ/.../stage_A/detections.parquet`
carry sub-1.0 confidence (range 0.450-0.981, mean 0.861) across all 3357
detections in window. Mean boxes/frame = 11.2 (vs 14 GT persons); only
1/301 frames hits 14 boxes. GT-injected pre-5 run writes to separate
`outputs/_gt_ceiling/` root. **Verdict: production detector, comparable
to the production GT trace.**
